hero_3d.type: Three.js / HTML5 Canvas / R3F custom canvas
elements: Pulsating Aorta with cardiac rhythm shader and illuminated blood velocity particles
Arterial tree (bright ruby & cyan glowing arteries) and Venous network (deep sapphire blue)
Catheter wire path glow following mouse cursor / gyro coordinates
Interactive hotspot markers for Brain (Stroke/Aneurysm), Aorta (EVAR), Liver (TACE/TIPS), Leg (PAD/DVT)
hero_3d.fallback: Smooth layered animated SVG canvas with glowing particle paths for low-spec/reduced-motion devices

features: Category switch: Peripheral (PAD, CLI, Angioplasty), Aortic (EVAR, TEVAR), Venous (DVT, May-Thurner, Varicose, IVC), Neuro (Coiling, Flow Diverter, Thrombectomy, Carotid), Hepatobiliary (TACE, TARE, TIPS, PTBD), Embolisation (UAE, PAE, Bronchial), Ablation (RFA, MWA, Cryo), Office-based (Biopsy, Drainage, Nerve block)

6-Step interactive timeline: 1. Normal Anatomy -> 2. Pathology/Disease -> 3. Access & Strategy -> 4. Catheter & Guidewire Navigation -> 5. Device Deployment / Embolisation / Stenting -> 6. Post-Intervention Hemodynamics
Controls: 360 Orbit, Zoom, Structure isolate, Normal vs Diseased toggle, Step-by-step playback, Annotations toggle

Dual Mode: 'Patient Explanation Mode' (clear, reassuring, plain English/Hindi terms) vs 'Physician/Doctor Mode' (French sizes, guide catheter selections, technical endpoints, hemodynamic data, sizing criteria)
Clinical metadata: Indications, Relative Contraindications, Risks, Recovery Timeline, Referral Guidelines
